units.source_text: 她说每月能赚一百元就够开支。

en.t: She said that earning one hundred yen a month would be enough to cover her expenses.

units.source_text: 上月赚得最少的人，是三百枝，合六十元。

en.t: The person who earned the least last month had three hundred sticks, equal to sixty yen.

units.source_text: 驹子赴宴九十多次，是最多的；赴宴一次，自己可以拿到一枝，因此对主家来说，虽吃点亏，但很快就会赚回来的。

en.t: Komako attended more than ninety banquets, the most of anyone; for each banquet she could keep one stick herself, so although the house took a small loss, it would soon earn the money back.

units.source_text: 在这个温泉浴场里，没有一个人因增加债务而延长期限的。

en.t: At this hot spring resort, not one person had had their term extended because of increased debt.
